baseline_caveat: This baseline was taken while content/evidence/records was still being written. Regenerate with 'efh rubric emit' once the evidence layer is complete; the RATCHETED counters may only rise, so a baseline taken too early is safe, and a baseline taken from an over-complete state would wedge the build.

reported_contract: Facts about the read-only OxFunc repository and about what OxFunc has measured. A rise produces a review note and never a red build: the Handbook does not control them, and ratcheting a fact about somebody else's repository would either be vacuous or would make an honest re-derivation fail CI.
